details.detail: Aisle vault: the arch between the bins, the 2-frame panel pitch, the lit colour and the new fade toward the centre-bin crease all read right. In v2 the vault runs from #ccccca at the crease to #fafafa by the grille. c_27312 (550,40) is #feffff and q06 (520,40) is #eeeeed. Measured in v2, the vault takes 48 % of the view width across its visible top edge, against 45 % in c119. The panel joints are the weak spot. In c119 each joint crosses the vault and then sweeps aft along the centre-bin side (c119 crop: (210,155) to (430,175), then curving down to (520,260)). In the model they are straight transverse ribbons 4 mm wide, and further than about 4 m away they render as dotted lines (v3 zoom, q15 top).

Slotted grille: FIXED. There is now one grille per aisle, on the outboard bin top, with 5 fore-aft slots in segments separated by solid bridges. It matches the c119 close-up in orientation and slot count, and the close-up no longer reads as piano keys (g_latch). What remains is the segment length. c119 shows about 2 segments per 2-frame panel (bridges at crop y 75, 150, 240, 290 against panel joints at 150 and 290), so about 0.5 m. The model uses 3 segments of 0.36 m.

Cove light: it now sits on the correct edge, but it is much too narrow. In c119 and b_sany_y22 the lit strip between the outboard bin crest and the grille is a broad, near-saturated band (#f6f6f6 to #ffffff), 1.5 to 3 times the grille width, and it is the brightest thing in the cabin. In the model it is a sliver about a quarter of the grille width (g_latch, q15 top, v1). The cause is that the grille sits at t = 0.10, so almost all of the lit vault strip (t < 0.06) is hidden behind the door crest.

Outboard bins: unchanged and still right. They come in 2-frame modules with one latch, one row placard and one seam per module, and the door is near-upright. The new top rail carries the placard as in c119 ('15' on a rail). The seams are now light hairlines, which fixes last round's black arcs.

Centre bins: the banding is FIXED. f_cbin column x=150 now falls smoothly from #f1f1f2 through #d3d4d6 to #c0c1c4, with no plateaus. The door wrap is broad and the channel is 0.60 m. At the far end of q15 the channel measures 0.26 of the centre-block width against 0.32 in y_47300, so it is no longer too wide. The black channel-edge lines match the photos (y_47300 #030207, b_sany_y22 #000000). The main difference left: c119 shows a raised top rail on the centre door carrying the '15' placard, and in the model the centre placard is printed straight on the door. The door carries a faint orange-peel noise from LAYER.plastic up close (h_trough). That is acceptable.
Latches: stadium plate, dark well and lever. Right size and position.

Outboard PSU: FIXED in concept. Each window bay has a recessed stadium well across the band, alternating 2 eyeball lights and 2 gaspers (v4), which matches thrifty_j_overhead-vent and b_lalf_c26. The band is still one flat plate with hairline joints. In the photos each well and the sign sit in their own slightly proud filler module with rounded edges and shadowed gaps, so the band reads stepped. The wells also have a soft raised lip (a sculpted recess), not a flat dark outline.

Centre PSU channel: y_47300 confirms the two transverse rows. The first is a stadium well with 4 fittings and the second is a row of 4 fittings (crop (540-720, 45) and (540-720, 72)). That answers questions_ceiling Q2 in favour of the model. The filler joints are uniform: 8 per 1.07 m module, so every 0.133 m. From below this reads as a slatted ceiling (v1, a_below). b_sany_y22 shows irregular panels instead: roughly a 0.3 m PSU panel, then 1 or 2 narrow strips.

No-smoking and seat-belt signs: FIXED. They are now flush pills with a smoked window showing amber icons with a red ring and arrow. The centre sign in b_sany_y22 (620-730, 270-290) is also a dark smoked pill, so the smoked lens is right. Outboard, b_lalf_c26 shows a lighter lens in the band plastic, which is close enough.
Row placards: larger, and readable on the outboard rail. They match.
Ceiling EXIT signs: a light double-faced box reading '← 非常口 EXIT →' under the vault at the zone ends (v3, q17). This matches b_sany_y22 (430,355) and (780,360).

Speaker and emergency fittings: the octagon is FIXED, and the ends are now round. What still differs: c119's big fitting (crop 420-570, 0-80) is a rounded rectangle with small corner radii, a thin rim, and a perforated field over the whole face. The model's full stadium with a narrower inner stadium reads as a double oval ring (h_trough, d_up).

Door-area ceilings: these can now be partly judged (v3, q01). There is a dome, fore-aft light strips, a round downlight and a fascia EXIT sign. Two problems. (1) Where the seat-zone vault ends at the door zone, a light-blue background colour (#c8dbec at v3 (380,302)) shows through between the centre-bin end, the vault edge and the dome: an open zone end with no header closure. (2) Over the door-3 area in v3, a flat white rectangle with a thick black edge (#131315 at (300,90)) hangs overhead. It may be a monument canopy (10_mono) seen from below, but it reads as a hole or dark void. q01 still places the camera between monument walls.

issues.detail: The cove light reads as a thin line. In the photos it is a broad, glowing band between the outboard bin crest and the grille.
issues.problem: Geometry and lighting proportion. The signature light feature of the 777 Signature Interior is under-scaled by a factor of about 4, so the vault edge looks like a trimmed seam rather than a light cove.
issues.evidence: c119 crop: the bright band (#f6f6f6+) is 90-130 px wide at the near end against a grille of about 40 px. b_sany_y22: the band on both outboard bins is at least as wide as the grille. The model (g_latch, q15_top): about 8 px of bright lip beside a 30 px grille. 07b TROUGH.ts = [0.10] leaves the lit vault strip t < 0.06 behind the door crest.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: move the grille inboard, TROUGH = { ts: [0.20], ... }. In eFn, return a plateau outboard of the grille: `if (ax > xg + TROUGH.w / 2 + 0.005) return 0.9;` before the exp terms, so the whole strip between the crest and the grille saturates. 08_bins.js sideBinModule: move the cove diffuser onto the visible crest and tilt it toward the aisle, e.g. `B.add(gBox(0.06, 0.006, L - 0.03), M4.trs(1.625 * side, 2.232, 0, 0, 0, -0.5 * side), { c: '#fbfbf8', r: 0.4, e: 1.0 })` in place of the hidden MAT.led box at x 1.70. Then re-check that the speaker panel at tc 0.78 does not crowd the moved grille.

issues.detail: Light leak at the seat-zone and door-zone boundary: background colour shows through beside the centre-bin end.
issues.problem: Artefact (gap). A saturated light-blue sliver appears where the vault profile ends and the higher door dome begins.
issues.evidence: v3_door3Up (380,302) #c8dbec, between the centre-bin end cap, the vault edge and the dome (v3_zoom, upper left). The vault gSweep is open at z0 and z1, and nothing closes the vertical face between VAULT and DOME/MONOC.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js buildCeilings, seat branch: for each side and each end z in [z0, z1], add a header closure `const hdr = [...VAULT.map(([x, y]) => [x * side, y]), [0.70 * side, 2.62], [1.70 * side, 2.62]]; upper.add(gExtrude(hdr, 0.012, 20), M4.trs(0, 0, z), CEILMAT.flat);`, reversing hdr for side < 0 if the winding flips. Also extend the 1.30 m centre gBox (y 2.325) by 0.02 past each zone end so it overlaps the dome.

issues.detail: The vault panel joints are straight transverse 4 mm ribbons that break into dotted lines at distance. In reality they sweep aft along the centre-bin side.
issues.problem: Artefact (sub-pixel aliasing) and a shape difference.
issues.evidence: v3_zoom (380-800, 360-380): dashed arcs. q15_top: dotted arcs on the vault. c119 crop: each joint crosses the vault and then curves aft toward the centre bin.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: widen profileRibbon dz from 0.004 to 0.008 and lighten CEILMAT.seam to #d6d8da, so the mips average to a soft line instead of dots. Optionally, shift the ribbon's z along the profile to sweep aft over the last 30 % toward the centre bin: in profileRibbon pass z + 0.25 * smoothstep(0.6, 1, k / (prof.length - 1)) for the port and starboard profiles.

issues.detail: The speaker fitting reads as a double oval ring. The real one is a rounded rectangle with a perforated field.
issues.evidence: c119 crop (420-570, 0-80): a rounded rectangle with small radii, a thin rim, and perforations over the whole face. h_trough and d_up: a full stadium with an inner stadium ring.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js: vaultPanel(0.78, side, zc, 0.34, 0.12, 0.025, ...) for the rim (r 0.025, not 0.05). Make the bezelIn panel 0.32 x 0.10 with r 0.018 so it fills the face, leaving about a 10 mm rim.

issues.detail: The centre-channel filler joints are uniform at 0.133 m (8 per module), so the channel reads slatted.
issues.evidence: v1_yCentreFwd and a_below: evenly striped channel. b_sany_y22: irregular panels (a PSU panel of about 0.3 m, then narrow strips).
issues.fix: 08_bins.js centerBinModule: replace the k<8 loop with joints at z = -L/2 + L * [0.18, 0.30, 0.62, 0.74] (paired joints bounding each PSU panel), or 4 evenly spaced (L/4).

issues.detail: The grille segments are about 0.36 m (3 per panel). c119 shows about 2 per 2-frame panel.
issues.evidence: c119 crop: bridges at y 75, 150, 240, 290, against panel joints at 150 and 290.

issues.detail: The outboard PSU band is one flat plate. In reality it is made of separate, slightly proud filler modules (the wells and sign in their own panels).
issues.evidence: thrifty_j_overhead-vent: stepped modules with rounded edges and shadowed gaps. b_lalf_c26: the well panel steps down from the bin.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js sideBinModule: in place of the 4 joint strips, add 2 proud pads per module (gRBox(bw - 0.04, 0.004, 0.26, 0.004, 1) at each window bay z = ±L/4, 2 mm under the band) coloured BINMAT.band, with a BINMAT.groove strip 3 mm wide at their fore and aft edges.

issues.detail: The centre-bin door lacks the raised top rail that carries the row placard.
issues.evidence: c119: '15' on a rail strip along the centre door top, the same as the outboard rail.
issues.fix: 08_bins.js centerBinModule: mirror the outboard rail. `const [gx, gy] = faceAtY(CBIN_DOOR, 2.17)`, then gExtrude(faceShell([[gx, gy], ...CBIN_DOOR.filter(p => p[1] > 2.175 && p[1] < 2.25)], s, -1, 0.009, 0.001), L - 0.014, 45) with BINMAT.rail per side, plus a groove. Bump placardXF's centre offset to 0.0105.

issues.detail: A white rectangle with a thick black edge hangs overhead in the door-3 area.
issues.problem: Possible artefact: a dark void or the underside of a monument canopy.
issues.fix: Identify the mesh (probably a 10_mono door-3 bar canopy). If it is the ceiling, close the MONOC or DOME ceiling over it. If it is the canopy, give its underside a light material. Hand to the monuments worker if it is theirs.
